target: Borrador de escena para fauna natural no combatiente de los Llanos de Edran; no integrar a runtime.
art_direction: Fase 2 usando como referencia obligatoria la Fase 1 aprobada. Mantener congelada la anatomía 4+2, pero reforzar una silueta no dinosauriana: torso horizontal suspendido y ligero entre seis apoyos, cuatro patas locomotoras largas y finas, dos apoyos anteriores cortos claramente separados, cabeza compacta no reptiliana integrada casi directamente al torso y sin cuello largo. Lámina dorsal flexible baja, pegada por el viento. Cola corporal muy corta, terminada inmediatamente en exactamente dos filamentos rígidos cortos. Fauna ambiental, no criatura de combate. Paleta fría/neutra de Edran: verdes agrícolas apagados, gris azulado y tierra parda; trigo pálido solo como acento menor.
prompt: Create one 1536x1024 landscape wildlife scene in the Llanos de Edran. Generate one VELOZANCO — imagine a GIANT GRASSHOPPER or CRICKET, but NOT with insect wings; instead, it has a low, thin dorsal membrane like a sail that's completely flattened against its back by wind. CRITICAL ANATOMY: The creature has exactly SIX slender legs: FOUR long, thin, identical legs arranged in two pairs down the sides of the body (like a grasshopper's main legs), plus TWO much shorter legs in front near the head (like a cricket's shorter palpus-like limbs). The HEAD is tiny, blunt, grasshopper-like with small simple eyes — exactly like a real grasshopper's head, NOT reptilian or dinosaurian. The body is low, horizontal, compact (think: grasshopper's oval body shape), barely above ground level. The TAIL is vestigial: almost no visible tail, just a very short fleshy bump behind the body with TWO tiny thread-like filaments emerging from it (like thread-thin antenna or sensory filaments, definitely NOT long spikes). The DORSAL RIDGE is a thin, soft membrane pressed completely flat by wind — like a grasshopper's folded wings if it had just one flat membrane instead of hard wings. POSE: Natural grazing posture in grassland, all legs supporting the weight equally, movement is slow and deliberate. PALETTE: Desaturated cool grassland colors — muted agricultural greens, blue-grays, brown soil, minimal pale straw accents. This is a small, harmless, delicate herbivore—think of it as a giant grasshopper variant, NOT a dinosaur or reptile.
negative_constraints: No dinosaur silhouette: no theropod, raptor, ornithopod or reptilian head/body proportions
No long neck, long snout, heavy hindquarters or bipedal-looking posture
No long tail and no long tail filaments; fleshy tail base and exactly two terminal filaments must all be short
Do not resemble a giant insect
Do not alter the frozen six-limb 4+2 anatomy: exactly four long locomotor legs plus two short anterior supports
No dorsal sail, rigid fin or wing; membrane stays low, soft and wind-flattened
No dominant ochre, amber, yellow or golden palette; pale wheat is a minor accent only
No sunset or warm golden-hour lighting
No glow, magic, attack pose, readable text or HUD
canon_sources: Issue #522 — Dirección de Arte, comentario del 2026-09-29
notes: Prompt reforzado tras autocrítica visual de v002: las generaciones previas parecían dinosaurio, alargaban la cola/filamentos y dominaban la escena con ocres. Mantener la referencia anatómica aprobada. Fauna ambiental no combatiente. No publicar ni integrar a assets/.
